issue.title: Use urgent priority for node shutdown cluster state update

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Node shutdown requests submit a cluster state update to initiate the
shutdown. Since the cluster may be overloaded, this update could take a
long time to be processed. This commit changes the priority to urgent,
so that shutdown requests can be processed as quickly as possible.

relates #84847

issue.title: Ack node shutdown requests after cluster state update is complete

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
The adding or removing a node to the node shutdown api stores submits a
cluster state update task to store the node metadata to be shutdown.
Sometimes a reroute is required, and in those cases we currently wait
for the reroute to complete before acknowledging the original request.
This commit changes the behavior to acknowledge success after the
cluster state update is complete. A warning is still logged if the
reroute fails.

relates #84847

issue.title: Add noop detection to node shutdown actions

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
When node shutdown apis are called to add or remove a node to be
shutdown, it is possible the given node is already shutting down. In
this case, there is no need to submit a cluster state update. This
commit detects when this no-op case occurs and simply returns.

relates #84847

body: Henning and I noticed another problem with shutdown task resiliency: we respect circuit breakers at both REST and transport layers. I think we should skip circuit breakers on these things, the requests themselves don't take much extra heap and it's important for them to succeed even if the cluster is mostly overloaded. I added an item to the list.

issue.title: Use batched executor for shutdown node actions

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
The transport actions for put and delete of the node shutdown api
currently use an unbatched executor. This commit converts the two
classes to each use a batched executor.

closes #84847
